title: Developing a Fidelity Evaluation Approach for Interpretable Machine Learning
reasoning: The paper is a technical evaluation of explainable AI methods, focusing on the concept of 'fidelity'—how well an explanation reflects the model's internal workings. It does not engage with topics of religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core part of its methodology or evaluation.
